baseline.attempt_counts_scope: per-caller histories; coalesced callers may repeat the same physical attempt
baseline.attempt_peak_rss_scope: maximum of registered-tree samples and backend supplements; observation kinds in backend_events when recorded; older untyped supplements remain unknown; not aggregate RSS or complete kernel tree high-water; sampled_peak_attempt_rss_bytes is a legacy alias
baseline.candidates_per_second_scope: returned consumer rows including cancelled/cache/coalesced results, not fresh native check throughput
baseline.task_latency_scope: internal acceptance availability after batch submission, including queue/retry/retirement; solved tasks only, unsolved IDs explicit; not streamed client delivery

limits: Lifecycle includes input/runtime/native retirement; excludes record serialization and executable loading. Keep external controller time and stderr resource logs. Pins and clocks are recorded claims, not independent authentication. First-success cancellation is not every-candidate RL parity. No speedup is admissible from ratios alone.
scope: matched own-engine native/prepared support measurement; not a strongest-warm-baseline or novelty claim; no timer/source/oracle change

tails.ranking: sum of native attempt wall durations, excluding queue; overlapping sums are not lifecycle
